answer:
FINALISED — the Enrichr odds ratio is NOT OBTAINABLE IN THIS ENVIRONMENT. No number is given because none could be measured and guessing was explicitly ruled out.

I treated "network unreachable" as a hypothesis to falsify and exhausted the provisioning routes, logging 48 attempts with exact commands and full stderr in analysis/RETRY_LOG.txt (produced by the rerunnable analysis/probe_provisioning.py). The claim is now verified, with the root cause identified rather than assumed:
• No connectivity at all: `ip -o addr` lists only `lo`; `ip route` is empty and /proc/net/route contains only its header (no default route). Raw TCP to 1.1.1.1:443, 8.8.8.8:53, 151.101.64.223:443 and IPv6 2606:4700:4700::1111:53 → OSError [Errno 101] Network is unreachable.
• No resolver: /etc/resolv.conf does not exist, nor does /etc/hosts; `getent hosts maayanlab.cloud|pypi.org` and socket.gethostbyname → socket.gaierror [Errno -3]. resolvectl → sd_bus_open_system: No such file. So the DNS error is downstream of (i)+(ii); neither is fixable without root, and a hand-written hosts entry would be pointless with no route.
• Proxy route tested and excluded: `env | grep -iE 'proxy|pip|index|http'` → "(none defined)"; `pip config list -v` finds no config at /etc/xdg/pip/pip.conf, /etc/pip.conf, ~/.pip/pip.conf, ~/.config/pip/pip.conf or the venv pip.conf; no ~/.netrc; and 127.0.0.1 proxy ports 3128/8888/8080/1080/8118 → ConnectionRefusedError [Errno 111]. There is no proxy to route the REST call through.
• Package routes: `pip install gseapy`, `pip install --retries 3 --timeout 30 gseapy`, `pip download --no-deps gseapy`, plus `--index-url` against Tsinghua, Aliyun, Tencent and HuaweiCloud mirrors all end in NewConnectionError [Errno -3]; pip cache dir /tmp/cache/pip does not exist; no conda/mamba/micromamba/uv/poetry/pipx; `find /` for gseapy*, pydeseq*, *.whl, *.gmt*, Reactome*, *gene_set* returns only the bundled pip/setuptools wheels; no R (/usr/lib/R, /usr/local/lib/R absent); requests is not even installed, so the REST fallback uses urllib. Only numpy/pandas/scipy/statsmodels/openpyxl are present.
• Endpoint retries at write time, all [Errno -3]: /Enrichr/datasetStatistics, /Enrichr/descriptor, /Enrichr/geneSetLibrary?mode=text&libraryName=Reactome_2022, maayanlab.cloud/static/gene_sets/Reactome_2022.txt, pypi.org/simple/gseapy/, codeload GitHub GSEApy tarball, reactome.org ReactomePathways.gmt.zip, Tsinghua JSON API, conda-forge repodata. Since no descriptor could be uploaded, gseapy.enrich could not run end to end; since gseapy does not import, its offline (local .gmt) mode is unavailable either, so no approximate OR was produced.

ANSWER TO THE QUESTION: "the odds ratio for p53-mediated cell cycle gene regulation (gseapy + Reactome_2022, DE genes p<0.05, |LFC|>0.5, baseMean>10, CBD/cisplatin combination vs DMSO)" is not obtainable in this environment — the required Enrichr service call cannot be made from the sandbox. executed_analysis=true refers to the DE half, which is complete and accepted; the enrichment statistic remains unmeasured.

WHAT THE READER MUST RUN TO CLOSE IT (one paragraph): on any machine that can reach maayanlab.cloud, copy data/ and analysis/, then run `pip install gseapy && python3 /workspace/analysis/run_enrichment.py`. That script loads the 1,680-symbol headline query (analysis/de_gene_symbols.txt), calls gseapy.enrich(gene_list=…, gene_sets="Reactome_2022", organism="human") with Enrichr's default background (falling back to the same /addList + /enrich REST endpoints if the package is unavailable), writes analysis/enrichr_reactome2022_full_results.csv, prints every p53 / tp53 / cell-cycle / G1-S / DNA-damage candidate row with Odds Ratio, P, adjusted P, overlap and gene count, and names the primary row by your tie-break. Then re-run with `--gene-list /workspace/analysis/de_symbols_t_df4.txt` (1,116 symbols) so the DE core's liberalness is visible in the OR. The 1,680-symbol raw-p list is the headline; the t(df=4) run is the robustness check. `--local-gmt <Reactome_2022.gmt>` now exists for gseapy's offline mode but writes *_APPROXIMATION.csv by design and is only valid if gseapy imports.

PREREQUISITES BY ARTIFACT: DE table → analysis/deseq_results_all_genes.csv.gz (63,677 genes) and analysis/de_genes_headline_rawP.csv (1,781 genes); query symbol lists → de_gene_symbols.txt (=de_symbols_rawP.txt, 1,680), de_symbols_t_df4.txt (1,116), de_symbols_padj.txt, de_symbols_up.txt/down.txt (248/1,432); executed script + log → analysis/run_analysis.py, analysis/run_analysis.log, analysis/summary.json; DE-core validation → analysis/deseq_equiv.py, analysis/validate_core.py, analysis/core_calibration.csv; blocker evidence → analysis/ENRICHR_BLOCKER.txt, analysis/RETRY_LOG.txt, analysis/ENRICHR_ATTEMPT_LATEST.txt.

REPORTING FIX APPLIED: query/background fraction now stated in the executed log, summary.json (query_background_fraction), README and blocker file — 1,680 symbols = 5.69% of the 29,540 testable genes (2.6% of the 63,677 rows) against Enrichr's default whole-library background (background=None), which is exactly why ORs on a list this size should be expected to be modest (~1.1–2 for leading terms, not 5–20) and must be read jointly with P, adjusted P and Overlap. I also hardened run_enrichment.py so its per-run failure notes go to ENRICHR_ATTEMPT_LATEST.txt instead of clobbering the curated ENRICHR_BLOCKER.txt (that had silently happened once mid-session and is fixed).
